table.name: TLGNC_CARRIER
table.description: Extends tlgns_sap_vendor by the LOGON specific attributes. Entries in this table are created automatically by the SAP-importer for any vendors which have a partner-function 'commercial carrier' or 'executing carrier'. For other vendor types (e.g. supplier) we do not create an entry in tlgnc_carrier.

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: PK. A carrier extends an tlgns_sap_vendor which is of type 'carrier'. The criteria for the automatic creation is: partner-function 'commercial' or 'executing' carrier exists for the SAP Vendor.

column.name: DISPLAY_NAME
column.description: Name to be used in the user interface of LOGON. Value is initially set to tlgns_sap_vendor.name1. For output documents (Delivery Note PDF) use always the name/address etc from tlgns_sap_vendor.

column.name: SAP_VENDOR_ID
column.description: FK TLGNS_SAP_VENDOR. The vendor which is extended by this record to a LOGON carrier. The entry in tlgnc_carrier is created by the SAP import, together with tlgns_sap_vendor) if it is indeed a carrier, and also the re-activation is performed by it. 1 : 0/1 dependency is enforced by a unique constraint.

column.name: BAG_STOCK_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SHIPPINGPOINT. Default (carrier stock) shippingpoint used by this carrier. If set, this value is used at the time of scheduling (creation of the assignment) as shippingpoint of the assignment-part 'loading' in case the order is a bag order

column.name: TRANSMIT_TO_CARRIER_FLAG
column.description: 0=false, 1=true. If true, orders assigned to this carrier will be transmitted to the carrier. Currently, this is only for transmitting to SBB (Swiss rail company), in the future this might be to other systems as well.

column.name: FREIGHT_REVENUE_CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_CURRENCY_BS. Currency in which the freight revenue is stored and displayed.

column.name: CARRIER_REQUIRES_PLANNING_FLAG
column.description: 0 = do not require planning (prescheduling), 1 = require planning (prescheduling). Flag to control if the planning process is required or not. Typical use case for this: FBNL.
